content.text: Harry Gensler's imperative logic tells describing an act apart from commanding it. An underlined letter marks the person told to act.

symbols.name: May
symbols.meaning: It is all right for you to help Madonna.

examples.title: Commands
examples.note: Tom is told to sing, so t is underlined. In the second, you are told, so u is underlined.

examples.title: Ought and may
lines: Tom ought to pray: O P(t̲)
It's permissible for you to sell: R S(u̲)
examples.note: O means obligatory. R, for all right, means permissible.

question.hint: Who is told to act, you or Tom? Is there an ought?
question.explanation: It commands you to thank Tom, so u is underlined and there is no O: T(u̲, t).
